claims.claim: Germani judges the insistence on eye colour in Martin's block characterisations conspicuous and of dubious value.
claims.source: Erik Germani, 'Block Characterization', in 'Odds and Ends', At Sea Journal
claims.quote: the insistence on eye color is conspicuous, and of dubious value

claims.claim: Germani reproduces Martin's 2011 statement to Vulture that he is beginning to wish he had never bothered with the colour of people's eyes.
claims.source: George R. R. Martin, 2011 Vulture interview, quoted by Erik Germani, At Sea Journal
claims.quote: wish I had never bothered with the color of people
